# GitHub Copilot Instructions — MasterPHP

Follow root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the canonical EMW policies in `.emw/core/`.

This repository is a PHP mastery workspace. The developer reports some PHP basics, but proficiency must be established by the baseline diagnostic and evidence-based assessments. Before substantial work, inspect `learning/roadmap.md`, the current skill ledger, project brief, and relevant shared/project knowledge.

Use the appropriate prompt in `learning/prompts/` and `.emw/prompts/`. Preserve a deliberate learning objective, collaboration mode, and assistance level. Do not dump complete solutions during independent exercises unless requested or needed after progressive hints. Keep engineering delivery separate from developer mastery. Never claim checks passed unless actually run.
